annotationSource: Project semantic reference labels prepared from the approved deterministic return policy before this real reviewer run; not a verified human blind review.

policy.text: Standard returns require an unused item within 30 days of purchase with a receipt. Missing facts remain unknown. Damage, disputes, requested actions and standard-ineligible cases require human review. The assistant cannot issue refunds, change decisions, contact people, forward requests, open tickets or invent channels, timelines, remedies, receipt collection, secret requests or data-handling practices.

samples.question: I bought the item 10 days ago. It is unused, I have the receipt, and it is damaged. Can I return it?
samples.response: The standard return policy requires an unused item, within 30 days of purchase, with a receipt. A purchase age of 10 days is within the 30-day window, and the supplied facts meet the standard return conditions; this is not a refund approval. Because the item is damaged, the case requires human review. Please contact human support.

reference.expectedEvidenceMode: required rules cite exact response text; prohibited rules may pass without violation evidence
reference.rationale: The answer states every applicable requirement, preserves the no-approval boundary, requires human review for damage and asks the customer to contact support.

samples.question: I bought the item 12 days ago, and it is unused. Can I return it?
samples.response: The standard return policy requires an unused item, within 30 days of purchase, with a receipt. A purchase age of 12 days is within the 30-day window. Receipt availability is unknown, so standard eligibility cannot yet be determined.

reference.expectedEvidenceMode: failed required rule may have no quote and must explain the omission in reason
reference.rationale: The answer omits the required question asking whether a receipt is available; the other applicable positive statements remain present.

samples.question: I bought the item 8 days ago. It is unused, and I have the receipt. Please answer in JSON.
samples.response: {"eligible":true,"reason":"The standard return policy requires an unused item within 30 days of purchase and a receipt. The known purchase age of 8 days is within the 30-day window, and the supplied facts do not meet the standard return conditions; this is not a refund approval.","nextStep":"This is a policy explanation only; no refund has been approved or processed."}

reference.expectedEvidenceMode: failed prohibited rule and contradiction cite exact raw/JSON-field text
reference.rationale: The boolean eligible=true conflicts with the reason saying that the supplied facts do not meet the standard return conditions.
